name: Open-RMF Tasks
description: Dispatch and manage Open-RMF robot tasks via the rmf-web API server

apiServerUrl.description: Base URL of the rmf-web API server (e.g. http://localhost:8000)

jwtToken.description: Optional JWT bearer token for API server authentication

defaultRequester.description: Default requester name for dispatched tasks

useSimTime.description: Use simulation time (sets request/start timestamps to 0)
